messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: canary cluster 'eu-west-2-canary' error-rate spike > 8% over 5m; latency sawtooth pattern, auto-rollout paused. Metrics: http5xx+ and tokenization timeouts. Auto-rollback not triggered (thresholds borderline).
jamal_oncall: ack — I'm on it. Paging SREs and eng. Starting triage now.
alex_m: looking at model variant shift in the canary logs. Seeing a pattern where requests with long context (>=4k) time out in the kv-cache layer — might be a kernel mismatch after last compile.
sophia_r: confirmed. Rolling traffic down to 0% for canary pool to stop user-visible errors. Executing traffic drain now.
jamal_oncall: good. Eva, are we seeing customer impact?
eva_ops: support reports ~6 customer errors in last 10m (chat widgets/timeouts). I'll open a short status note in status.redwood if this becomes >10 users.
alex_m: propose two-step: 1) flip feature flag for the new model compile (feature.flag.model_compile_v2 = off) 2) if errors persist, manual rollback to prior model image (model:v2026-03-01).
sophia_r: agree. Flipping flag is safest first step. Jamal — can you confirm RBAC for flag toggle?
jamal_oncall: I have access. Flipping now -> `feature.flag.model_compile_v2: false`
jamal_oncall: flipped. Observability: error rate dropped to ~2% in the drain window. Latency smoothing starting but still seeing intermittent 504s for long-context requests.
alex_m: ok hold — I still see some in-flight KVs on canary nodes. I'll trigger graceful eviction of canary pod group and start manual redeploy to previous image. Command: ```./deployctl promote --cluster eu-west-2-canary --image model:v2026-03-01 --strategy replace --wait```
sophia_r: running traffic-siphon -> draining connections then cordon nodes. Running `kubectl drain` variant now.
ejamal_oncall: redeploy command acknowledged and running (watching logs).
eva_ops: support updated: reduction in errors, customers on affected tenants see fewer timeouts, leaving support channel open for escalation.
alex_m: redeploy finished. Smoke checks: sample generation, auth flows, streaming all look good on canary after redeploy.
sophia_r: verifying autoscaler behavior and KV cache warmup metrics — everything looks normal.
jamal_oncall: roll forward halted and replaced with previous image; monitoring for 30m. Preparing short postmortem checklist and rollback timeline.
eva_ops: drafting customer-facing blurb in status page, ETA ~15m.
jamal_oncall: handing off active on-call to sophia_r for 2hr watch. Summary: flipped feature flag, drained traffic, redeployed prior model image, KV warmup verified. If error-rate creeps above 3% reopen this thread and call pager. :white_check_mark:
sophia_r: taking handoff, will watch metrics and confirm 30m stability before closing. :eyes:
